'''Coruum Sa'dia''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman who owned and operated the [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] concern [[Zelcomm Industries]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The company was in truth a front for an illegal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation and Sa'dia directed his illicit business personally from within [[Zelcomm Tower]], the headquarters of Zelcomm Industries, which was situated in [[Sector 1265]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], a customer of Zelcomm Industries, went on the run from the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], Sa'dia encountered a group of Pyke-affiliated agents who ventured [[Zelcomm Tower]] in search of information on Leeachos' activities.<ref name="UABS" />
